dropped.t: • Company’s liquidity position remains strong, with $81 million in cash and cash equivalents and $9 million in restricted cash, an unencumbered tangible equity position of $75 million in the UK Bank, which upon expected closing of sale in Q1 2027, is expected to generate an additional $65 million of cash to the Company

As late as the August 3rd board meeting, the day I was fired, the Company’s own projections were estimating that we were on track to over $1.5 billion of volume, over $53 million of revenue, and $12 million of Adjusted EBITDA loss, which, if achieved, would have handily came in at the top end of the guidance range on all three metrics.
Preliminary third quarter Loan Volume was $1.395 billion, within the Company’s previously issued guidance range of $1.375 billion to $1.525 billion.

The Company expects to recognize a non-cash reversal of approximately $7 million to $8 million of stock-based compensation expense in the third quarter, primarily reflecting the forfeiture of unvested equity awards following the departure of former directors.

“Our third quarter Loan Volume was within guidance, but revenue came in below our guidance range as interest rate headwinds and the proxy contest weighed on conversion and partner launches,” said Loveen Advani, Chief Financial Officer of Better.
“Excluding approximately $8 million of proxy-related expenses, our Adjusted EBITDA loss would have been within guidance, which shows the underlying cost base held.

In the fourth quarter, we expect to still face headwinds from the proxy contest actions in our October numbers but believe we will be able to cut expenses and improve conversion efficiency for November and December”

Following completion of the remaining disposal, we do not expect to generate material revenue from these operations.As such, the revenue from our non-core international operations is winding down.
We do not expect to generate material revenue from these non-core international operations in future periods.
In addition, the Company determined that the planned disposal represents a strategic shift that is expected to have a significant effect on the Company’s operations and financial results.

The Company expects that the results of discontinued operations will continue to be impacted by operating performance, changes in interest rates, and any additional adjustments to the carrying value of the disposal group prior to sale.

Accordingly, other companies, including companies in our industry, may calculate similarly titled non-GAAP financial measures differently or may use other measures to evaluate their performance, all of which could reduce the usefulness of our non-GAAP financial measure as a tool for comparison.
